## Summary & Expertise
Rakesh Patnam is a Python-focused software engineer (B.Tech, Computer Science) with 1.9 years of experience building tested Python, Django and Flask applications and automation, backed by SQL and Linux skills, and working directly with clients in fast-paced Agile teams. He replaces manual processes with reliable, documented scripts and uses AI-assisted tools responsibly to speed up coding and debugging. He has built Python AI/ML projects (a TensorFlow CNN and a PyTorch NLP chatbot with REST API integration) and completed Generative AI training.

- **Chatbot Song Recommendation System**
  - Description: Python conversational assistant built from scratch with NLTK and PyTorch that interprets user intent and mood from natural language dialogue and recommends music via the Spotify REST API.
